title: Macarena and Palacio de Dueñas Tour
text:
A wonderful experience, thanks to María José, our guide!!
Her explanations were very interesting and at the same time entertaining!!
Without a doubt, highly recommended for getting to know Seville!!! Thanks Majo!!
author: 239mariajes_sb

title: Seville
text: Very good tour, I recommend it, my wife and I did it and it was spectacular, and the guide Maria Jose is a nice and wonderful girl, she made everything very pleasant, a 10 for her
author: O9254BFfelixm

title: The importance of a good guide
text: The tour is highly recommended. Mari Paz, our guide, was a very good host; she made it enjoyable, full of historical facts, and enlivened with curiosities throughout the tour. Her enthusiasm and the kindness she showed us at all times deserve special mention. Honestly, it couldn't be better.
author: juanra713

title: Macarena Tour - Dueñas Palace
text:
Everything very well explained by our guide Álvaro. An incredible memory 👌🏻
On the other hand, what should be improved is the meeting point at the Setas, as it should be more specific, for example, in front of the square where the letters are, with a shirt of color x or an umbrella of color... everything else was great.
author: 1indirat

title: Visit to Palacio de Dueñas with Alvaro
text:
We have visited the Palacio de Dueñas with Álvaro. 
He has been very attentive at all times. The explanations were magnificent. 
We had a very pleasant day thanks to Alvaro's professionalism.
author: H4923XWcarmenc

title: Visiting Seville with Álvaro
text: Álvaro is a guy who knows the secrets of Seville very well; we got to know the city in depth. It was a very good experience.
author: antoniovC5277HN

title: Visiting Seville with Alvaro
text: Our guide Alvaro was wonderful. He made the tour very enjoyable for us, a great professional, and you can tell he loves what he does.

title: Visiting Seville with Álvaro
